operational.description: Repository availability and observable default-branch automation health.

governance.description: Portfolio review, status-declaration, lifecycle, and repository identity governance checks.

assurance.description: Repository-specific assurance evidence coverage, execution state, provenance and freshness against governed repository revisions.

cross_specification.description: Cross-specification pressure-test evidence is not yet ingested as a portfolio-wide assurance dimension.

findings.subject: .github/workflows/pages.yml
findings.claim: Required assurance evidence was not observed inside the governed evidence window.

evidence.reason: no completed workflow execution was observed inside the governed lookback window

findings.recommended_action: Restore or execute the repository-native assurance control and publish observable evidence.

remediation.objective: Restore or execute the repository-native control required by the governed assurance contract.
acceptance_criteria: The required evidence is observable inside the governed lookback window.
The evidence is attributable to the configured repository-native control.
verification: Execute the required repository-native control and rerun the portfolio monitor.
